newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia noon rubber down on poor demand.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia noon rubber down on poor demand.

text.p: The Malaysian rubber market extended losses at noon session with poor demand and bearish sentiment continuing to ease sentiment.
"There was poor demand this morning. There was hardly any active inquiries but some local dealers' covering was seen," a dealer at a trading firm said.
Demand from Far East was also slow with consumers only checking on prices.
Dealers offered SMR CV at 318 cents, SMR L at 299, SMR 5 at 269, SMR 10 at 249, SMR 20 at 248 and latex at 215.
